incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: P1 model-load-failure triggered for service=redwood-serving runtime=prod model=rwkv-5b-quant-v2. Incident INC-2026-0315 created. Paging sam (oncall).
sam (oncall): got it, joining. what's the failure?
devon (ml-infra): seeing repeated load errors on a subset of pods during warmup. logs show a mix of deserialization errors and CUDA OOM during init.
maria (support): customers reporting 502 / slow starts for chat endpoints. looks like ~1200 failed requests in last 10m, some customer sessions degraded.
sam (oncall): can someone paste the exact error?
devon (ml-infra): sure, copying from failed pod:
```
[2026-03-15T16:02:11Z] ERROR ModelLoader: failed to deserialize tensor: UnexpectedDimension for tensor "layer_23.weight" expected 2048 got 0
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"/opt/app/loader.py\", line 412, in load_weights
    tensor = deserialize(stream)
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.9 GiB (GPU 0; 31.75 GiB total capacity; 29.8 GiB already allocated)
```
lee (sre): also seeing nvrtc compile timeouts on the same host: `NVRTC_ERROR_COMPILATION` and then fallback compile retries.
sam (oncall): nodes affected?
devon (ml-infra): pods with host gpu-id: gnode-17{3,4,5}. Looks like memory fragmentation + a bad checkpoint shape for this model variant. Only newer pinned build (v2) shows it. older quantized variant (v1) loads fine.
maria (support): which customers are impacted? Ops dashboard shows two enterprise tenants on dedicated routing to this model (acme-inc, betafoods). I sent them a short message and opened tickets.
ops-bot: Route table update queued: divert requests for model=rwkv-5b-quant-v2 -> rwkv-5b-quant-v1. Requires approval.
sam (oncall): approve the route change, do it. we need quick mitigation.
lee (sre): I'm on it — updating routing to fallback model and throttling warmup concurrency to 1 per node.
devon (ml-infra): temp mitigation ideas: 1) route to v1 (smaller quant) 2) disable parallel warmup to reduce peak allocs 3) restart affected kubelets to clear GPU memory fragmentation 4) bump node to larger instance if traffic requires.
sam (oncall): execute 1 and 2 now. defer node restarts until after fallback confirmed.
lee (sre): routing change applied, verifying metrics. saved config: `route: rwkv-5b-quant-v2 -> rwkv-5b-quant-v1` for prod cluster zone us-west-2a.
[system] 16:08:23 UTC route-change: successful
maria (support): I'm updating customers: letting them know we routed to fallback and are investigating root cause. asking if they'd like retry on their side.
devon (ml-infra): after routing change, error rate dropped ~85% and successful model loads for v1 increased. but we still see a few v2 load attempts (old connections) failing with: `DeserializationError: unexpected EOF while reading tensor metadata`.
sam (oncall): devon, can you check the model artifact on storage? checksum mismatch possible?
devon (ml-infra): running checksum now. command: `sha256sum s3://models/rwkv/5b/v2/checkpoint.tar.gz` — returning different hash than published. looks like partial upload happened during last deploy.
lee (sre): that explains deserialization errors + corrupted tensors. nvrtc timeouts probably due to fallback compile and retries after corrupted load.
sam (oncall): action items: devon to re-publish artifact, lee to keep routing to v1 and monitor, sam to coordinate with support for customer comms and SLA log, maria to maintain customer-facing updates. handoff planned if incident persists beyond 30m.
devon (ml-infra): re-upload started: `aws s3 cp models/rwkv/5b/v2/checkpoint.tar.gz` -> progress 45%
ops-bot: autoscaler: reduced warmup concurrency -> 1, applied to cluster prod/us-west-2a.
lee (sre): I’m marking gnode-173/174/175 as drained for new loads to avoid repeated failures until we validate the re-upload. draining now.
maria (support): updated acme-inc and betafoods: routed to fallback, ETA for full fix ~25-40m. they acknowledged.
sam (oncall): devon, ETA on verification after upload?
devon (ml-infra): checksum matches now. rerunning model verify script: `python tools/verify_model.py --model rwkv-5b-quant-v2 --check-all`
devon (ml-infra): verify logs: `all tensors present, shapes ok, lightweight load pass succeeded (no deserialization errors)`
lee (sre): before we re-enable v2, recommend smoke test on a single canary node with no other warmups. I'll spin one canary in us-west-2b.
sam (oncall): agreed. lee proceed, devon prepare rollback plan if reissue. maria standby on comms.
[system] 16:31:02 UTC canary-create: instance canary-17 created in us-west-2b
devon (ml-infra): deploying v2 to canary with reduced parallelism and `--no-warmup` off (we'll warmup single thread). logs: initial load success on canary. memory profile: peak 26.2 GiB.
lee (sre): canary looks good for 12 minutes. I'll promote to a small percentage traffic (2%) and monitor for OOMs/compile errors.
sam (oncall): promote.
[system] 16:45:10 UTC traffic-shift: 2% -> rwkv-5b-quant-v2 canary
devon (ml-infra): monitoring: no OOM, no nvrtc timeouts, CPU/GPU steady.
maria (support): customers notified of canary promotion. acme-inc replied: fine to observe.
lee (sre): after 18m stable, I'm going to increase to 10% then full if green.
sam (oncall): heads-up: I need to hand off in ~10m to lee for overnight oncall. I'll compile incident notes.
lee (sre): I'll take it. please include list of actions and affected customers.
sam (oncall): notes: root cause = partial/corrupt artifact upload leading to deserialization errors + OOMs during retry/fallback; mitigations = route->v1 fallback, reduce warmup concurrency, drain affected nodes, re-upload artifact, canary test, progressive traffic promotion. SLA impact: ~1200 failed requests, two enterprise tenants briefly degraded, no data loss. next steps: post-incident RCA and fix deploy pipeline to verify uploads with checksums before publish.
maria (support): adding logs to incidents system and sending final update to customers after lee confirms stable.
lee (sre): taking over now. will run longer-term: full node reboots and GPU driver check in maintenance window, and add pre-publish checksum gate to CD pipeline.
sam (oncall): thanks team. handing off to lee — I'm OOO after 17:15 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315 status: Stabilized. Current state: routing->fallback applied, canary green, rollout paused. Assignees: lee (sre), devon (ml-infra).
lee (sre): capturing logs & postmortem ticket now (PM-INC-2026-0315). I'll ping when RCA drafted.
maria (support): i'll close customer loop once final RCA is ready.
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance: reboot gnode-173/174/175 in 2h window for fragmentation mitigation.
lee (sre): thanks, closing active chat. will update channel on RCA and any policy changes.
